SUPERIOR COURT OF NEW JERSEY
MIDDLESEX COUNTY SUPERIOR COURT
SHERIFF'S SALE NO. 26001328
DOCKET NO. F00504619
PLAINTIFF – NEW JERSEY HOUSING AND MORTGAGE FINANCE AGENCY
DEFENDANTS- TYRONE A. TIPPETT, ET ALS.
Writ of Execution.
By virtue of the above stated Writ of Execution to me directed and delivered I will expose for sale at public vendue on
Wednesday THE 2nd DAY OF September 2026
between the hours of twelve and five o'clock in the afternoon of said day, that is to say at 1:30 P.M. prevailing time at The Heldrich Hotel, 10 Livingston Avenue, New Brunswick, New Jersey 08901 to wit:
All that tract or parcel of land, situate, lying and being in the Borough of SOUTH RIVER, County of Middlesex and State of New Jersey:
Being known as: LOT 1.03 FKA 1.3 BLOCK 402
PREMISES COMMONLY KNOWN AS:
116 DARROW STREET SOUTH RIVER, NJ 08882
A more complete metes and bounds description can be found in the Office of the Middlesex County Clerk.
Lien(s)/Taxes: County: Middlesex
Municipality: Borough of South River
Street Address: 116 Darrow Street, South River, NJ 08882
Tax Lot: 1.03 f/k/a 1.3 Tax Block: 402
Approximate dimensions: 100.00' x 80.00'
Nearest cross street: John Street
The Plaintiff's Upset Bid presently approximates $345,000.00.
Occupancy Status: UNKNOWN
"THE SHERIFF HEREBY RESERVES THE RIGHT TO ADJOURN THIS SALE WITHOUT FURTHER NOTICE THROUGH PUBLICATION.’'
Note: The street address is merely given as a convenience to the bidders and is not a representation of fact on the part of the sheriff. The diagram or concise description does not constitute a full legal description of the premises, but it can be found in the Middlesex County Clerk’s Office.
Subject to any unpaid taxes, municipal liens or other charges, and any such taxes, charges, liens, insurance premiums or other advances made by plaintiff prior to this sale. All interested parties are to conduct and rely upon their own independent investigation to ascertain whether or not any outstanding interest remain of record and/or have priority over the lien being foreclosed and, if so, the current amount due thereon.
If the sale is set aside for any reason, the Purchaser at the sale shall be entitled only to a return of the deposit paid. The Purchaser shall have no further recourse against the Mortgagor, the Mortgagee and the Mortgagee’s attorney.
Surplus Money: If after the sale and satisfaction of the mortgage debt, including costs and expenses, there remains any surplus money, the money will be deposited into the Superior Court Trust Fund and any person claiming the surplus, or any part thereof, may file a motion pursuant to Court Rules 4:64-3 and 4:57-2 stating the nature and extent of that person's claim and asking for an order directing payment of the surplus money. The Sheriff or other person conducting the sale will have information regarding the surplus, if any.
The approximate amount due on this execution is $255,507.96 plus interest, cost, printers’ fees, Sheriff's fees and commission. The prior liens, as per affidavit of consideration are not a representation of fact on the part of the Sheriff.
MILDRED S. SCOTT
SHERIFF
DATED: June 1, 2026
PLUESE, BECKER, SALTZMAN & THOMAS LLC
20000 HORIZON WAY SUITE 900
MOUNT LAUREL, NJ 08054
856-813-1700
